reviews.t: Perfect for adding into my whipped shea butter
reviews.x: Perfect for adding into my whipped shea butter, love the big jar it comes in and the big chunks of pieces.

A fine-quality product for making hand creams, and (almost uniquely, alas) honest weight - almost an ounce over, even. Also a particularly convenient form of packaging: chunks in a jar is ideal for handling and storage, and whether one uses just a little at a time or all at once, much easier than either squeezing chunks from a messy bag, or having to melt a whole jar. Will be buying this one again (I hope).

Already have another jar of this in my shopping cart. I expected the butter to be wonderful, and it is. What I didn't expect was the jar. It's heavy duty and perfect size for reuse as a body butter jar. It doesn't really have a smell, but it works well for soothing chapped skin that had suffered from a chemical burn.

This stuff is awesome!! I use it to make homemade chapstick and I haven't found anything creamier or better than this. I also chose this product because it is unscented so when making homemade products I can add whatever essential oils I wish without an overpowering scent from the mango butter. I thought the broken up nature of this butter was a little strange at first but it works great so that part doesn't really matter, especially when it will be melted down most of the time anyway.

It was a little dryer than I expected, but when you melt it down, it's lovely. Great for homemade body butters. It has a very strong cocoa scent. I love this line, I also bought there mango butter. I highly recommend.
Arrived as promised and works great in the lotion bars that I make.

On here they list the ingredients as, "Aloe Vera butter" and absolutely nothing else, which is exactly what I wanted. I purchased this, then on the container it states the ingredient actually also include Coconut oil, Hydrogenated vegetable oil, and Vitamin E oil. They falsely advertised this product, and I wouldn't have paid $15 knowing it included Hydrogenated vegetable oil. I purchased this for, and tried using this on my young child with terribly dry skin. It is really lovely cocoa butter smells delicious and feels great on skin.  The only complaint I would have is that there was a lot of powder in the jar .  I looked it up and found it didn't really mean anything bad but was expecting just chunks.  Anyway it does make it easy to measure and there are still chunks to choose from as well.

This is the first mango butter that I've bought. That being said, I was very happy with the product. It resembles exactly what I've read a good mango butter should, and has worked out well for me. Would buy again.

Arrived on time, packaged perfectly, no melt during delivery which is awesome!  This butter melts on the skin right out of the jar and I can't wait to use it for my lotions and oils.  Purchased it because I don't really care for the overpowering smell that shea butter has and prefer the skin care properties that mango butter has.

reviews.t: Which vegetable oils have been added to this product?
reviews.x: It seems ok, but I seem to have bypassed the part it has vegetable oil added, I'm not really happy about. And I would like to know what vegetable oil am I place on my body. Is it canola oil, corn oil which either one is not very high on the list of things I want to rub into my skin and hair.
Good quality - Great for soap!  Be careful following body butter recipe - doesn't work as simply as directions in listing suggest, but easily fixed with a few adjustments.

reviews.t: Creamy | Moisturizing  |  Excellent Product! Highly Recommend!
reviews.x: Amazing product! I did not realize how large this was going to be, but you get a lot of the olive butter. It contains hydrogenated vegetable oil so it stays solid and does not melt. It works great because olive oil is the main ingredient. I use it as a scalp treatment and facial moisturizer. I wanted something more natural based. This product's formulation keeps it creamy, almost like a whipped olive butter so it is easy to apply. I am so happy I gave this product a try. I will definitely contin

This mango butter is excellent for making whipped body butters.  It is a very creamy butter that is not grainy or greasy like shea or coconut butter.  The packaging and quality is great.  I will definitely be using this from now on in my body butters.

Was disappointed in myself for not digging deeper to find the ingredients before using, as the third ingredient listed after aloe and coconut oil is hydrogenated vegetable oil, something I tend to avoid whenever possible.

reviews.t: I use it for my hair
reviews.x: I use mine specifically for hair. I add a couple of oils to make it more smooth and creamy. I recommend this for people with high porosity hair and dry hair, especially in the winter time.

reviews.t: This product is perfect, I love it
reviews.x: This product is perfect, I love it. I made a body butter with mango butter, coconut oil, and grape seed oil. It is perfect for winter.
Great product in lotion bars and lip balm! Smooth and luxuriously nice!
Lots of chuncks and last for awhile depending on  what you use it for
Amazing! This is the real Shea butter that I have been looking for!
Received container with a crack in it. The powder  is coming out.
A wonderful product. I would buy again with no hesitations
Use it for newborn and it is super wonderful.

I have extremely sensitive combination skin and I use this mainly as a moisturizer for my face. It is the one thing I've tried so far that doesn't clog my pores but keeps my face from being dry and flaky in DC winters. I also use this after epilating and it soothes my skin and leaves it feeling nice and soft. A little goes a long way which means the amount you get is really great for the price. Moreover, it's unscented which makes it great as a base to add to a hair or body butter recipe.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's quality and creamy texture for making body butters, lotions, and other homemade products.
Many reviewers appreciate the generous weight and convenient jar packaging, often noting the jar is reusable.
Several reviewers value that the butter is unscented or has a pleasant scent, making it easy to customize with essential oils.
A few reviewers complain about undisclosed added ingredients, such as vegetable oil or coconut oil, not listed in the product description.
Some reviewers report inconsistent quality or texture issues, including a fishy smell and excessive powder in the jar.
